title: little m: An AI Agent for Industrial Process Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.16680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manufacturing consumes one third of global energy and still has significant room for improvement in terms of energy efficiency. Optimal process control is essential for this purpose. However, synthesizing mathematical optimization models from messy, real-world industrial specifications requires bridging unstructured natural language and spatial diagrams with rigorous mathematical syntax. This poses a profound challenge for general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), which may introduce invalid constraints when tasked with modeling continuous multi-physics dynamics. To address this, we introduce little m, an AI agent designed to assist the formulation of industrial process control models. Combining a domain-specific knowledge repository with LLM-driven interaction, the proposed framework formulates real-world optimization problems as mathematical models. translated_title: little m：一个用于工业过程优化的AI智能体
translated_abstract: 制造业消耗了全球三分之一的能源，在能源效率方面仍有很大的提升空间，而最优过程控制对实现这一目标至关重要。然而，从杂乱的真实工业规范中构建数学优化模型，需要将非结构化的自然语言和空间图表与严谨的数学语法相衔接。这对通用大语言模型（LLM）而言是一个严峻的挑战，因为在建模连续多物理场动力学时，LLM可能会引入无效的约束。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了little m——一个旨在协助构建工业过程控制模型的AI智能体。该框架结合了领域特定知识库与LLM驱动的交互，能够将真实世界的优化问题表述为数学模型。为了进行系统性评估，我们引入了工业过程控制基准测试（Industrial Process Control Benchmark）。
tldr: 本文提出了little m——一个结合领域特定知识库与大语言模型交互能力的AI智能体，能够将非结构化的真实工业规范转化为严谨的数学优化模型，并配套引入工业过程控制基准测试以实现系统性评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces little m, an AI agent that combines a domain-specific knowledge repository with LLM-driven interaction to formulate messy, real-world industrial specifications into rigorous mathematical optimization models, accompanied by the Industrial Process Control Benchmark for systematic evaluation.
